<script>
    function toggleMenu() {
      const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
      menu.classList.toggle('open');
    }
    function toggleDropdown(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const dropdown = event.target.parentElement;
      const dropdowns = document.getElementsByClassName('dropdown');
      for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
        if (dropdowns[i] !== dropdown && dropdowns[i].classList.contains('open')) {
          dropdowns[i].classList.remove('open');
      }
    }
      dropdown.classList.toggle('open');
  }
    window.onclick = function (event) {
      if (!event.target.matches('.dropbtn')) {
        const dropdowns = document.getElementsByClassName('dropdown');
        for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
          const openDropdown = dropdowns[i];
          if (openDropdown.classList.contains('open')) {
            openDropdown.classList.remove('open');
        }
      }
    }
  };
</script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const showBox1 = document.getElementById("showBox1");
    const showBox2 = document.getElementById("showBox2");
    const box1 = document.getElementById("box1");
    const box2 = document.getElementById("box2");
    if (showBox1 && box1 && box2) {
        showBox1.addEventListener("click", function() {
            box1.style.display = "block";
            box2.style.display = "none";
            document.querySelectorAll("a.curso").forEach(function(el) {
                el.classList.remove("active");
            });
            this.classList.add("active");
        });
    }
    if (showBox2 && box1 && box2) {
        showBox2.addEventListener("click", function() {
            box2.style.display = "block";
            box1.style.display = "none";
            document.querySelectorAll("a.curso").forEach(function(el) {
                el.classList.remove("active");
            });
            this.classList.add("active");
        });
    }
    const faqQuestions = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-question");
    faqQuestions.forEach(function(question) {
        const answer = question.nextElementSibling;
        const arrow = question.querySelector(".arrow");
        if (answer) {
            answer.style.display = "none";
        }
        if (answer && arrow) {
            question.addEventListener("click", function() {
                document.querySelectorAll(".faq-answer").forEach(function(otherAnswer) {
                    if (otherAnswer !== answer) {
                        otherAnswer.style.display = "none";
                    }
                });
                document.querySelectorAll(".arrow").forEach(function(otherArrow) {
                    if (otherArrow !== arrow) {
                        otherArrow.classList.remove("rotate");
                    }
                });
                answer.style.display = answer.style.display === "block" ? "none" : "block";
                arrow.classList.toggle("rotate");
            });
        }
    });
    const scrollTopButton = document.getElementById("scrollTopButton");
    if (scrollTopButton) {
        scrollTopButton.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
        });
    }
});
</script>

		"itemListElement": []
	};

	var validaBreadCrumb = $('.bar-trilha').find('ol').hasClass('breadcrumb');
	console.log(validaBreadCrumb)
	if ( validaBreadCrumb ) {
		$('.breadcrumb li').each(function() {
			var position = $(this).find('meta').attr('content');
			var id = $(this).find('a').attr('href');
			var name = $(this).find('span[property="name"]').text();

			if(id === undefined) {
				id = window.location.href;
			}

			var itemInfo = {
				"@type": "ListItem",
				"position": position,
				"item": {
					"@id": id,
					"name": name
				}
			}

			jsonContent.itemListElement.push(itemInfo);
		})

		setTimeout(function() {
			var stringfiedContent = JSON.stringify(jsonContent);

<script>
	$(function(){
		function accentsRemove(string) {
			com_acento = 'áàãâäéèêëíìîïóòõôöúùûüçÁÀÃÂÄÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÕÖÔÚÙÛÜÇ';
			sem_acento = 'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUC';
			newstring='';
			for(i=0;i<string.length;i++) {
				if (com_acento.search(string.substr(i,1))>=0) {
					newstring+=sem_acento.substr(com_acento.search(string.substr(i,1)),1);
				}
				else {
					newstring+=string.substr(i,1);
				}
			}
			return newstring;
		}
		setTimeout(function(){
			var url = location.href;
			$("ul.menu-paginas a h4 span, ul.menu-paginas a span").each(function(){
				var menu = accentsRemove($(this).text()).toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "-");
				if(url.indexOf(menu)!==-1) {
					$("a[aria-controls='tab_"+menu+"'").addClass("clicar");
					$(".clicar").click();
				}
			});
		}, 2000);
	});
</script>
